description: Calculate a person's numerology life path number from their birth date, exactly as Anahana's free Life Path Calculator does: month, day and year each reduced to one digit, keeping the master numbers 11, 22 and 33, then added and reduced again (1-9, 11, 22 or 33). Returns the number, its title and meaning (English), the method, the matching angel-number article and the calculator page in the language asked for. Read-only; the birth date is not stored.

birth_date.description: The birth date as YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "1990-07-04".

language.description: Language for the linked pages, e.g. "de". One code; defaults to "en".

name: calculate_life_path_number
title: Calculate a numerology life path number
